objective: Proof: knots confined to a window cannot make a line; growing a line one distinction at a time, every step must add a constraint holding both the start and the new distinction, and with one knot per step the knot is forced (B(start, end, new)); the states alone identify the two ends, leaving one free bit per step; the grown line is a pairwise base whose disagreement count is an exact ruler.
title: Growing a line forces each new knot to reach the start
